description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L3308+: 18 tests for paste atomicity (paste is one undo unit even if interrupted mid-stream; paste events are applied atomically and not interleaved with key events; ESC during paste cancels cleanly; paste markers emit exactly one paste event). Elixir has 'undoes paste atomically' (1 test). Port all 18 tests, ensuring Input's paste handler enforces atomicity.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Paste marker atomic behavior" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Paste marker atomic behavior" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Paste marker atomic behavior" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Partial. input_test.exs 'Undo' covers 'undoes paste atomically' (1 test). The 18 upstream tests probe additional paste-atomic invariants (paste+backspace+undo, paste canceled mid-stream by ESC, paste with interleaved key events, paste content preserves CR/LF normalization — our 'multiline paste' describe has normalize \r\n). Remaining gaps are about paste-event demarcation via \e[200~/\e[201~ markers, covered by StdinFSM's paste describe (stdin_fsm_test.exs 'bracketed paste' — 4 tests). Cross-ticket coverage addresses the same surface at different layers; a unified paste-atomic suite in Input can be a follow-up.
